# Test fixtures

- `tiny.jpg` — 8x8 red JPEG generated with ImageMagick 6 from a solid color canvas.
  It is released under CC0-1.0 and contains no personal metadata.
- `tiny.mp4` — 1 second, 64x64 MPEG-4 video with a 440 Hz AAC audio tone, generated with
  FFmpeg's `testsrc` and `sine` sources. It contains no personal media.
- `tiny.md`, `tiny.odt`, `tiny.docx` — the same short test document in Markdown, OpenDocument
  Text, and Office Open XML. The ODT/DOCX files were generated with LibreOffice from the
  same test text. CC0-1.0; no personal metadata.
